ops.statement: Any residual / calibration / stability diagnostic computed over a self-weighted or smoothing predictor (drift fit, RTS smoother, kernel) MUST use leave-one-out (out-of-sample) prediction. A self-inclusive form pins the prediction to each point's own value and is structurally blind to the very failure it exists to detect (sigma-too-small / over-claiming, between-session instability). When a crew flags this class once, sweep the whole module for sibling diagnostics rather than fixing only the flagged instance.
